title: Elderly Couple Reunites After 8 Months – Viral Tears & Love

segments.text: After 8 months apart, a Canadian couple’s tear-filled reunion went viral and made the world smile.
They’ve been married for 62 years, but for more than eight months they lived in separate nursing homes; the exact reason for the separation remains unclear.
In late August, a photo of them crying during a visitation went viral, thanks to their granddaughter Ashley Bartyik sharing it.
On Thursday, September 22, Wolfram was moved into the same care facility as Anita, and the reunion was captured in photos of them smiling, kissing, and embracing in what they called 'happy tears'.
This story shows how community support can overcome institutional barriers worldwide.
So from 62 years of love to eight months apart, this story reminds us that family and public support can bring people back together.
Share this story – let’s keep the world smiling.
